text.feels_intro: How {name}'s shock burns feel right now; let this shape {his} tone, posture and movement:
text.feels_outro: Answer must be creative and different, repetition will be punished.

head: {name}'s face: a blush of pink flushes the cheek and temple where the sparks played, the skin unbroken; tiny muscles beside the eye and mouth flicker on their own, and the fine hairs on {his} brow stand on end. A thin, sharp smell of ozone hangs about {him}.

{name}'s face: delicate, fern-like red tracery branches across the cheek and jaw, with pinpoint grey-white burns where the sparks bit in; the eyelid on that side keeps fluttering and the corner of the mouth twitches. {name} smells of ozone and singed hair.

{name}'s face: deep, blistered entry burns ringed in black pit the cheek and brow, the branching marks swollen dark red; the whole side of {his} face jerks in uneven spasms, the lips are pale and the eyes glassy and unfocused. The acrid stench of scorched skin and burnt hair clings to {him}.

{name}'s face: the pinpoint burns have dried into small, dark scabbed craters, the fern-like tracery faded to a dull brownish web; now and then a muscle under the cheek still gives a small, stray twitch.
{name}'s face: the scabs are gone, leaving tiny, glossy pink pits and a faint rosy branching pattern that shows when {he} flushes.
{name}'s face: only a few small, pale pinprick scars remain, with a ghost of the branching pattern visible when {his} skin is cold or flushed.
body: {name}'s back: a faint pink flush spreads across the shoulder blades, the skin raised in gooseflesh; the muscles beneath it ripple and quiver in small, uncontrolled twitches. {name} smells of fresh sweat and a sharp trace of ozone.

{name}'s back: red, fern-like burn patterns branch across the shoulders and down the spine, dotted with pinpoint entry burns; the long muscles bunch and jump in cramping knots under the skin. {name} smells of ozone, sweat and singed cloth.

{name}'s back: deep, black-rimmed entry burns are seared into the skin, the branching marks swollen and blistered; the muscles clench in hard, rolling cramps, and {his} whole body shudders in fits, drenched in cold sweat. The acrid smell of burnt flesh and sour sweat clings to {him}.

{name}'s back: the entry burns have crusted into small, dark scabbed craters strung along the faded brown tracery; the muscles still jump in an occasional stray twitch. A faint smell of healing salve lingers.
{name}'s back: glossy pink pits mark where the burns were, joined by a soft rosy branching pattern that comes up when {he} is warm.
{name}'s back: small, pale pinprick scars remain, and a faint fern-like ghost shows across the shoulders in the cold.
arm: {name}'s {part}: the skin is flushed pink along the forearm, the hairs standing on end; the fingers curl and twitch on their own.

{name}'s {part}: red, fern-like burns branch from the wrist toward the elbow, with pinpoint grey-white burns where the sparks bit; the forearm muscles cramp in visible knots and the hand trembles. It smells of ozone and singed hair.

{name}'s {part}: deep, blistered entry burns ringed in black are seared into the arm, the branching marks swollen and weeping; the hand is locked in a clawed cramp and the whole arm jerks in spasms. It gives off the acrid smell of scorched skin.
{name}'s {part}: small, dark scabbed craters dot the arm along a faded brownish web; the fingers still give a stray twitch now and then.
{name}'s {part}: the scabs have fallen away, leaving glossy pink pits and a faint rosy branching pattern along the forearm.
{name}'s {part}: a few small, pale pinprick scars remain along the arm, with a ghost of the branching pattern when the skin is cold.
leg: {name}'s {part}: a pink flush spreads over the thigh or calf, the skin pebbled with gooseflesh; the muscle beneath it flickers and twitches.
{name}'s {part}: red, fern-like burns branch across the thigh or calf, with pinpoint grey-white entry burns; the muscle cramps into a hard, visible knot. It smells of ozone and singed skin.

{name}'s {part}: deep, black-ringed entry burns blister the thigh and calf, the branching marks swollen dark red; the muscle is seized in a rigid cramp and the leg jerks in fits. An acrid stench of seared flesh rises from it.
{name}'s {part}: small, dark scabbed craters dot the leg along a faded brownish web; the calf still gives an occasional stray twitch.
{name}'s {part}: glossy pink pits mark the old burns, with a soft rosy branching pattern across the skin.
{name}'s {part}: a few small, pale pinprick scars remain, the branching pattern visible only faintly in the cold.

head: {name}'s face prickles and crawls as if ants were running under the skin, and {his} teeth buzz with a metallic taste. {name} is jumpy and indignant, blinking hard against the twitch in {his} eyelid.

{name}'s face burns in sharp, needle-point stings, and the muscles of the cheek and jaw cramp and jump without warning. {name} is frightened and humiliated; {his} words come out clipped and uneven as {his} mouth twitches mid-sentence.

{name}'s face is searing, jolting agony, numb in patches and on fire in others, {his} vision flashing white and {his} heart racing hard. {name} is in shock and barely coherent; {his} jaw clenches in spasms and {he} can hardly shape a word.
{name}'s face itches and stings around the scabbed burns, and a stray twitch still tugs at {his} eyelid or lip. {name} is self-conscious and tired, speaking carefully in case {his} mouth jumps.
{name}'s face is oversensitive where the burns were, prickling at a touch or a cold wind. {name} flinches when a hand comes near {his} face.
{name}'s face feels normal again apart from an occasional faint prickle or a lone twitch. The crackle of magic nearby makes {him} flinch, a quiet memory of the sparks.
body: {name}'s back prickles and tingles, the muscles twitching in small, maddening jumps. {name} is tense and hyper-alert, {his} shoulders drawn up, {his} breath catching at every flicker.

{name}'s back stings with needle-point burns and the long muscles cramp in hard, aching knots, while {his} heart beats fast and shallow. {name} is shaken and resentful, holding {reflexive} stiff and hunched, {his} breath coming in jerks.

{name}'s back is deep, searing burns and cramps that wrack {his} whole body in convulsions, {his} heart pounding and stumbling in {his} chest. {name} is terrified and close to collapse, unable to straighten, shaking uncontrollably and gasping.
{name}'s back itches around the scabbed burns, and the muscles still cramp or twitch when {he} turns too fast. {name} is weary and careful, moving slowly and wincing at sudden jolts.
{name}'s back feels tight and tingly over the old burns, with a stray twitch when {he} is tired. {name} is wary and keeps anyone from standing too close behind {him}.
{name}'s back has its full strength and ease again, with only an occasional lone twitch. The crackle of a spell nearby still makes {him} tense, a quiet memory of the sparks.
arm: {name}'s {part} prickles and buzzes from the shoulder to the fingertips, the fingers jumping on their own. {name} is startled and shakes the arm out, keeping it close.
{name}'s {part} burns in sharp pinpoint stings, and the forearm cramps so the grip keeps failing. {name} is shaken and irritable, cradling the arm and fumbling anything {he} holds.
{name}'s {part} is searing agony, numb and burning at once, the hand locked in a cramp that will not let go. {name} is in shock and despair; the arm is useless and jerks in spasms {he} cannot stop.
{name}'s {part} is stiff and itchy around the scabs, and the fingers still twitch when {he} grips hard. {name} is frustrated and avoids heavy or fine work.
{name}'s {part} tingles faintly over the old burns, and the hand trembles a little when tired. {name} has accepted it; the arm works with only minor clumsiness.
{name}'s {part} has its full feeling and strength again, with only a rare stray twitch. The crackle of magic still makes {him} flinch, a quiet memory of the sparks.
leg: {name}'s {part} prickles and buzzes, the muscle twitching in small jumps. {name} is unsettled and shifts {his} weight, with a brief hitch in {his} stride.
{name}'s {part} stings in sharp pinpoints and the calf or thigh cramps into a hard knot. {name} is shaken and vulnerable, walking stiff-legged and stopping to wait out the cramps.

{name}'s {part} is searing burns and a rigid, wrenching cramp, the leg jerking in fits that will not hold weight. {name} is panicked and exhausted, {his} heart racing; {he} cannot stand on it and needs support to move.
{name}'s {part} itches around the scabs and cramps when {he} walks too far. {name} is weary of the slow recovery and limps a little, resting the leg when {he} can.
{name}'s {part} tingles over the old burns, with a stray twitch at night or in the cold. {name} is regaining confidence, walking almost normally.
{name}'s {part} has its full strength and movement again, with only a lone twitch now and then. The crackle of magic still makes {him} flinch, a quiet memory of the sparks.

levels: , a sudden crackle of sparks dancing over bare skin. The prickling sting snaps through {his} nerves and the muscle jumps on its own, leaving a buzzing tingle behind and the sharp smell of ozone in the air.
over skin that is already prickling and raw. The sparks bite into the fresh burns, and the twitching muscle knots into a hard, aching cramp that drives the breath from {him}.

, and the sparks dig into blistered burns. The cramp becomes a wrenching spasm that rolls through {his} body, {his} heart lurches and races, and an involuntary cry is torn from {him}. The smell of ozone and scorched skin rises.

, and it is too much. The current floods already-ruined flesh; {he} convulses helplessly, cold sweat pouring, {his} heart hammering and stumbling, {his} vision whiting out as {he} loses all control of {his} body.
